name: hbm_sfu_store_leaf2_r9d_1017

pin_regs.reason: the leaf RTL registers every input at the pin (pure flops: rb/we_q/addr_q/data_q/start_*_q) and every output is a stripe register (calendar/valid/active/done/fault/ordinal/mm); a kit flop stage would add an edge to the priced r9 schedule

structural_change: r9c (HBM-SFU9 10-17, coordinator HANDOFF 0db rejected r9 leaf2: clock + every pin on the W face of 425x194, TT insertion 525 / spread 160): COLUMN leaf, 4 SRAMs as one abutted N-S stack, all R0, so every macro A edge (clk, rd_out, addr, wd_in[0:135]) faces ONE W band that holds the register mass (cfg copy low half, captured, calendar, stripe control) and every B edge (wd_in[136:255] + ties) faces a thin E band. Each data bit has ONE physical destination side: in_data_lo[135:0] W face, in_data_hi[119:0] E face over its full length (wrapper port split only, bit-identical). Stripe pages are vertically adjacent (page mux local). Pins spread over the full W and E faces (M4), each stripe calendar leaves at its own rows, clock pin at W mid-height beside the register mass. r9d: the r9c gates FAILED trial GRT (M4 overflow 307 / 921: the abutted stack left no horizontal crossing under the M5 cap, so E-band clock/control went round the stack, TT insertion 449/507, spread 204/156); r9d splits the stack into two halves with one 21.6 um crossing channel at mid-height, exactly where the clock and control pins enter. Outline 280.8 x 349.92 (1.25:1). Cycles unchanged vs r9.

job.purpose: SFU programme store r9c column leaf (2 stripes, 4 SRAMs) for ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store_r9 (3x leaf3 + 1x leaf2). CRITICAL (hbm_sfu_programme_store): coordinator reviews the gate PNG before submit.
